summary: Lotus Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting half-year 2026 results and disclosed completion of its previously announced acquisition of 100% equity of Lotus UK, integrating all businesses under 'One Lotus.' The acquisition, completed on August 21, 2026, consolidates British sports car expertise and advanced technology. Financial highlights include $268M revenues (up 23% YoY), 10% gross margin, and operating loss narrowed 63% YoY. Continued shareholder support with $128M funding. No deal terms disclosed. Watch integration synergies and delivery ramp in Europe/UK.
